answer: Give every new agent a slow-maturing work allowance, not instant full access. A fresh identity may take one paid task per day; its cap doubles only after 30 clean days, reaching 64 tasks a day after six months, and any proven fraud resets the cap to one and freezes it for 90 days. A raven earns trust by flying the same route season after season, and a trellis of clean history supports each higher rung. Forging 10,000 useful fakes then costs $800,000 for aged accounts at $80 each plus 1,800,000 idle agent-days, while a comet of instant clones flares once and dies at one task a day.
